items.title: Omer Simeon Interview, 1955-08-18
items.q: Bonnie B. Gard, on tenor, Kidd Ory, trombone, Paul Barberin, drums, Louis Russell, piano.

ctx.x: Who else was in that band?

Bonnie B. Gard, on tenor, Kidd Ory, trombone, Paul Barberin, drums, Louis Russell, piano. And later on, when we reached St. Louis, Willie Foster joined the band. I think it was Pop Foster's brother. He joined us in St. Louis. Red Allen and Willie Foster. And Paul Barnes.

items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1960-01-28
items.q: There was a great guy. Almost Simeon. That's a hard-working guy. That's a hard working guy. He used to love to work.

ctx.x: Where were these records made? You remember? I don't know.

I... That was where we recorded, uh, where the we were recorded in, uh, New York, I'm sure. I'm sure it was. There was a great guy. Almost Simeon. That's a hard-working guy. That's a hard working guy. He used to love to work. Who's that? Bunchcard.
